data.title: Crypto Stocks Slide as Bitcoin and Ethereum Hold Flat: Circle Internet and Bitmine Fall 4%, Coinbase Drops 3%
data.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum are barely moving this Tuesday, yet the stocks built around them are crashing open sharply lower. A shock from an unexpected corner of the market explains why crypto equities are suddenly trading as if the coins themselves had collapsed.
data.author: David Moadel
